Date: 2022-06-23
ABSTRACT
METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR CONTROLLING AUTOMATED VEHICLE
Monitoring driving safety information before a vehicle enters a curve or when the vehicle has entered the curve; obtaining a position of the vehicle in response to the driving safety information; obtaining curve information, where the curve information includes at least one of a position of a start point of the curve and a position of an end point of the curve; and controlling, based on the position of the vehicle and the curve information, the vehicle to stop at a position outside the curve. In this application, a risk of accidents such as a rear-end collision caused by a vehicle stopping in a curve can be avoided, and driving safety of an automated vehicle can be improved.
